name: Granular Synthesis
description: Sample-free polyphonic stereo grain3 synthesizer with 30 performance controls. From sparse grains and glassy clouds to dense pads, noisy swarms and sync-like tones. Two independently seeded grain streams; harmonic/odd-even source shaping, five grain windows, pitch/phase scatter and distributions, evolving density/duration/phase/pitch, resonant filters, ADSR and stereo width. Pan and output level are set in the performance rack. Best MIDI 36–84. Window: 1 Hamming, 2 Hann, 3 triangle, 4 Blackman, 5 Blackman-Harris. Window, transpose, sync, follow and seed round to integers. Performance controllers apply to NEW notes; internal motion continues on held notes. Dry Stereo Output: route to Master; add shared reverb/delay to taste.
